nom: Shiseido Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream

avis.titre: I would definitely buy this again
avis.texte: Very rich formula. I love the hydration and how it makes my under eyes look

avis.titre: Don't Wait, Get This Eye Cream!!!!
avis.texte: Amazing product! Love, love, love this eye cream. Very nourishing and have seen results in two weeks! I will buy this cream again and again!

avis.titre: Don't know if I will keep buying this product.
avis.texte: I really like this product and how it is light on your skin but still not seeing any true results after using for over a year now. Still have my wrinkles under my eyes. Not seeing any dramatic results.

I really love the silicone paddle applicator! I apply this eye cream as a last step in the p.m. and it works its magic through the night. I cannot say my aging eyes are less wrinkly, but they seem happy to have the extra attention from this soothing cream. Try it!
I absolutely love it I found the complete cleansing microfoam and I am in love❤️ excellent product thank you
Doesn't work at all. Been using for 10 weeks, and no change under my eyes.
Product is creamy, not greasy and I use it twice a day. Feels good on my eyelids and around my eye. Only thing I use.

I've used Shseido eye cream for at least 28 years. I was disappointed when they changed the formula to a thinner consistency, but have grown used to it. I have made the mistake of buying knockoffs and they are not the same. I am very pleased with this product and will continue to use it Heidi

I have used Mary Kay's eye cream for years, but feel like the quality has declined, so I am searching for the new "Holy Grail". This eye cream is nice for me because I have extremely dry skin. It is very greasy. I would think it would be a bad choice for someone with oily skin. I will be trying Clarins' eye cream after this.
I use this since I remember myself using any cream for my face .
I do not use this product but my mom swears by it. She has been using it for years, and always get complimented. I may need to think about adding this to my routine as well soon.

avis.titre: Love this - will be a repeat buyer
avis.texte: This product is awesome - I'll be rebuying. Purchased because a friend had it and upon trying it was the best eye crème I've used, and now I won't look back. So hydrating and brightening. #sweepstakes

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again
avis.texte: My favorite eye cream product I ever had, I been using this product since 2015 , must item for my skin care routine!
No other eye cream even comes close to this product. It is so silky soft and hydrating around the eye area. I will continue to use for the rest of my days.

Works great! In my 50's and woke up one day with wrinkles and crepey skin under my eyes. Tried other brands, but they all irritated my skin and made things worse. This cream was soothing in comparison to others.
I use BWSEC daily am and pm. It's not a watery eye cream but a lil more creamy and smooths nicely around my eyes. I just received and have been using one month. I love the silky feeling of it.

I have sensitive skin and sensitive eyes. This eye cream caused no irritation but it also was not effective. I found little benefit to using it. I finished the jar and switched to another product and saw improvement in fine lines and wrinkles.
I have used this product since over 10 years and couldn't be happier Keep up the great successful work., UBH most satisfied customer 'user
So greasy. The skin simply fails to absorb it. And, it smells like a stale cream. So disappointed. I'm returning it.

I purchased this eye cream after I ran out of my usual product to try something different. A friend recommended it, so I bought it. I do like the feel of it on the skin around my eyes but was surprised that it is scented! Usually, expensive products are unscented, and I do not like the smell. Why have a scented product near the eyes? The packaging is a bit over designed, as though the cream must be worth the high price because it comes in a heavy jar with a fancy cap. Between the scent, packaging, and price, I won't purchase this again.

avis.auteur: complements no wrinkles on my EYES
avis.titre: Only Shisiedo eyes cream works! Had tried many other brands
avis.texte: I have been use shiseido eyes cream since I'm 24year old. The thickness of the cream is excellent, it will absorb in to the eye areas. If someone needs shiseido lite eyes cream check it out more options
This eye cream is definitely worth the money. Goes smoothly and moisturizing area I needed. This is the best eye cream I've ever been used.
Product is a bit too thick for me. It's kind of hard to use it around my eyes. I have to use a cotton swab to gently dot it.

I've tried a couple products that claim to help smooth under eye wrinkles. None worked! There was a sale on this and I decided to try it after reading reviews. This DOES work for under eye wrinkles! I was putting it at night only and by morning there wasn't much difference. I started using it first thing in the morning before getting ready and it SIGNIFICANTLY reduces my under eye wrinkles! It does wear off a little during the day but, works the best if any product! I don't know how it works for bags or dark circles because I don't have those issues. THIS IS A GAME CHANGER!
Love the eye cream ever needed one but I am applying it to my neck as my neck is very sensitive to anything and this I see has been great.
I received sample with other purchase. Eye cream is very hydrating. Moisture lasts all day. The only downside is the fragrance added which is irritating to sensitive eyes.
This product feels good but I am not sure I have seen the results I thought I would.
Love this eye cream. It's moisturizing and feels so good after applying.

I have been using this product for last 15 years and loved it until the company changed original formula. The new formulation lives my eyelids swollen, itchy , red and irritated for already 4 months . It also clogged my oil glands which makes condition of my eyes even worse .was not sure the product was the reason of my eyelids condition until read about new formula and about similar experiences another consumers had based on the new formulas in this product Used to say " will never be using anything else besides this product " , however never say nrvee
I've used this for a year or two now, and nothing else compares. I can always tell on my eyes when I'm not using it. So silky & smooth.

I've been using Shiseido products for many years, but this is my first time trying this one, and I'm happy with it so far. However, when I first took the container out of the box, the seal on the lid was partially peeled off. It made me uncomfortable because it seemed like someone might have opened or used it. Still, I decided not to return it.

avis.titre: On my Second One, Great for the Eyes!
avis.texte: I'm 46 and loving this eye cream so much! Its rich, moisturizing, and perfect for maturing eyes. I use it morning and night and notice my under eyes look less tired and feel smoother and more hydrated. Will absolutely repurchase!
This product is hydrating and thick. I know it is expensive, but I buy it when on sale. It is worth the money.

This eye cream has a very nice texture, but doesn't absorb into my skin, just sits on top. I also noticed it makes my eyes look puffy. I live Shiseido face cream, but theeye cream just doesn't work for me.

I bought this based on the positive reviews and I like Shiseido's products. Overall, I have normal skin and let me tell you this product is extremely thick and greasy. Even with the most minimal of product, you can't avoid how thick it goes on. It actually messes with my mascara because my mascara transfers onto my eye area because it's such a heavy eye cream. With that being said, I do believe it's a good product and i am hopeful it will work long-term. I'm going to try putting it on at night as an eye cream and in the morning just use my regular serum and face lotion. Hopefully I will still see the same results from the eye cream.

This is brilliantly emollient and thick and so so smooth. I believe it is the nicest eye cream I've used so far except for Gerlain. In fact I would put it on par with Gerlain except Gerlain admittedly smells a little bit better (more like candied violets and less like chemicals and musk) but costs something like four times as much. Or more. So since this scent is really faint enough to completely forget about within a few minutes of putting it on and since it is so very emollient and and moisturizing, I will probably be sticking with this one. I wish there was one like this that had SPF.

avis.titre: Rich for dry skin, 2 stars less for packing
avis.texte: I've been using it for some months, like how rich and moisturizing it is. I bought from othr department stores too, but Ulta has the worst packaging. Shiseido always have sealing sticker but I just received my package today, the box and seals on the jar all look opened, and missing portions that I've never noticed before when purchased from somewhere else. Disappointing.

I tried a sample of this before buying a full size. It's very hydrating and I really like it under makeup. I'm 44 with notmal skin so this may work if your skin is older or normal to dry. If you have oily skin, it may be better at night.
i like it, don't love it. a little too frangranced for my taste and a little too pricey for my pocket. would not buy again.
Unfortunately I'll never know how well this stuff works long term because I can't stand how greasy it is. It doesn't absorb. Then it gets in your eyes.amd burns.
This is definitely the best Eye cream I've ever used. I'm fussy too. My eyes feel so soft and look much better!

avis.titre: i would buy it only when on sale
avis.texte: product is rich and moisturizing but feel plastic applicator is unnecessary
This is the only eye cream I ever use. Been using it for years. You can't go wrong because it lasts a long time. Very good for young & mature skin around the eyes.
I wanted to love this but it didn't absorb into the skin easily, it just sat on top and didn't seem to help my skin at all. I ended up returning it.
I have used this for years, wouldn't be without it. It's thick creamy and moisturizing. I have very sensitive eyes.

This is the best eye cream ever. I stock up during every 21 days of beauty sale, but if it didn't go on sale I would still buy it (but I wouldn't hoard the way I did during the sale lol). It makes my under eyes look brightened and younger. I love it. This is a staple product for me.
This is a great product. It's actually moisturizing and my concealer works well with it.

avis.titre: Feels amazing, sensitive skin folks beware
avis.texte: First, this eye cream feels amazing on the eyes. It's ultra hydrating, and I've been using it for a month so I've yet to see results but the reviews left me confident that I would. Unfortunately, this cream is also ultra fragranced. Using no other actives besides a sunscreen in the day, I gradually began noticing stinging the morning after application. Until it became as pictured. There's minor swelling and tight shiny red skin on my upper cheeks. I do not think this is a product for sensitive skin and urge others with sensitivities to look elsewhere! Discontinuing use due to sensitivity alone, and I wish this would've worked for me.
I love to feel I love the texture. I love the hydration. I love the shine. Definitely recommend perfect day or night. Worth it. Happy I purchased it and will purchase it again.

It is NOT acne safe, or even remotely "non-comedogenic." It contains MINERAL OIL ffs - what a cruel joke. Thanks for the 3-week (deeply painful, cystic acne) breakout; u know the kind - that was clearly caused by a thick oil or 5. I'm so tired of trying to avoid all these oils in products that are clearly labeled "non-comedogenic" and/or "acne safe." NEITHER OF THOSE TERMS MEAN ANYTHING ANYMORE. It is def NOT acne safe or non-comedogenic with mineral oil in it, & u kno it, because of that greasy all day feeling, where it just slimes around your face & gets on everything. If they could leave all of these cheap greasy *pore-clogging* oils out of our products, our skin would be SO thankful!! Oh but wait - then we wouldn't buy 10x more products to fix the damage/cover it up! Great business model. Not so great for us tho. xoxo
I like the consistency of the cream and it has SPF in it, but it has a very strong scent, and I don't like my cosmetics to have smells to them. If you don't mind the smell, I would recommend it.
My got to eye cream. I have tried all of the trending ones, but keep coming back to this. It delivers.

avis.titre: i would buy this product again
avis.texte: I've been using the Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream for about a month, and I can see a visible difference in my fine lines and puffiness. The cream is rich but absorbs quickly and doesn't leave a greasy feeling. My under-eye area feels softer and looks smoother. The scent is light and pleasant. The only downside is the price, but a little goes a long way so the jar lasts quite a while. I would recommend this eye cream to anyone looking for a solution to dryness and early signs of aging around the eyes.
It works immediately for bags and wrinkles under the eye. The visual results last all day! The results are drastic.
Twice daily ! I thick it is a little too thick but I like the amount in the bottle
Me and my mom, we are obsessed with this product. And if you add patch on top of it for 20min, 10 years younger. One of my favs!!!

I am very happy with benefiance wrinkle smoothing eye cream, it goes on smooth, does not feel heavy when you put it on, a small dab goes a long way. Skin around my eyes feel nourished. I most definitely recommend it!

This is the only eye cream that I can put around my who eye and it does not make my eyes watery when I rub my eyes. It feel thick and takes a little longer for it to absorb in the skin. Worth every penny

avis.titre: Not for those sensitive to fragrance
avis.texte: Overly fragrant! I could not get past the perfume type scent from this product. Caused eye irritation and burning. Eyes looked worse for using in all actuality.
I only use this eye cream. I have sensitive skin and no problems. I have been using this for years.
I really like this eye cream, it is very moisturizing and has helped with the fine lines around my eyes. I think it's worth the cost!
It soaks into my very thin skin and significantly reduces fine lines and wrinkles

avis.titre: Makes Me Look Much Younger Than I A (according to others)
avis.texte: I love this product. Yes, love is not an exaggeration, but the feeling I get when I look at 76 year old face in the mirror, and there are no lines, wrinkles anything but soft skin under and above my eyes (forehead) I use it religiously at bedtime, and sometimes during the day. I continue to encourage my husband to also use it, an d he complains it is greasy. Note, it isn't greasy, he just applies too much. Use a little bit, and massage it into your skin. You;ll see the difference, quite a difference
This cream is rich and especially good and beneficial during winter time. Make the eye area feeling smooth and soft.
I am a skeptical person but this DID make a difference for me within a few weeks of daily use. Can't go without it now!!

avis.titre: Not for someone with fragrance allergies
avis.texte: I'm pretty sure the itchy, red, flaky skin under my eye I developed immediately after using this product was from geraniol (fragrance). Otherwise, it has a very nice consistency and does a good job at moisturizing the eye area.
Accept no substitutes: this is the only eye cream you'll ever need. I once tried a cream by Chanel that sent me scrambling back to Shiseido Benefiance.

I had a stubborn wrinkle coming in over my left eye. It really stood out to me and I was worried I would need laser treatment or some other serious intervention. Turns out my skin just needed some good hydration ! This eye cream works like magic to me. Not only is that wrinkle MUCH less defined, to the point where it looks even with the other eye again, the other wrinkles around my eyes have also softened a lot. I can't recommend this product enough.

avis.titre: Use Caution if you have allergies
avis.texte: I like the way it hydrates and it absorbs nicely leaving smooth skin behind. I have extra dry skin and tap on once more if I am wearing makeup in the evening. However, I stopped using this product because my left lower eyelid skin becomes flaky and reddened, I think because of the fragrance (geranoil). I've had allergic reactions to that in other products (hair balm) in the past. Sorry, because it is a nice, silky smooth elegant cream.
I love this eye cream and I am told how smooth the area around my eyes look. I never have dry areas when I put this on at night.

I love all Shiseido products, the serum, the face moisturizing cream and now the smoothing eye cream. It's so creamy and luxurious and does wonders for this 55-year-old skin. I'm completely hooked. Honestly, I look forward to applying this eye cream every day before my makeup. I highly recommend.

Got this eye cream in a kit with the face cream (which I actually like very much). The eye cream quite frankly is a basic eye cream and a bit pricey. It was kinda greasy on my 59yoa eye area, and did not help my concealer wear better, which I had anticipated. It's not a terrible product, I just found it to not really be special nor worth the expense.

I love eye creams, and I've tried almost every one you can think of from budget to prestige. Shiseido is the GOAT of eye creams. I hate to say it because I am a firm believer in buy budget unless it's worth your coin. This is. It's worth every penny.

avis.titre: Disappointed After Years of Loving This Eye Cream
avis.texte: I've been using this eye cream for a long time and absolutely loved it — it used to be my go-to product. It kept my eye area hydrated, smooth, and never caused any irritation. Unfortunately, the most recent jar I purchased was completely different. After just a few uses, my eye area became itchy, dry, and red — something I've never experienced with this product before. I'm so disappointed because this used to be one of my favorite skincare staples. I don't know if the formula has changed or if there was an issue with this batch, but I can no longer use it. Sadly, I'll have to look for a replacement.

avis.titre: New formula nothing like the old formula
avis.texte: Used the old formula for years and it was the only thing that helped my dry undereye area. New formula is nothing like it and should be marketed as an entirely different product. Very disappointed.

avis.titre: Yes, I will be buying this again.
avis.texte: I am almos 68 in February and need everything that will to help my skin. This eye cream is wonderful and so smooth. I'm so happy that I bought all 3 items.
I tried this eye cream based on prior reviews. I like the consistency of the cream. It improves the look of the skin around my eyes immediately upon applying the cream.
Way to greasy. Never had a problem with your products before. Used to use white Lucent anti dark circle eye cream. It was discontinued. So disappointing

avis.titre: I will always buy this excellent eye cream !
avis.texte: This is the best eye cream ever ! I have used it always since I 1st tried it . I've tried many others as a professional esthetician , nothing compares ! Thank you
Staple in my routine. So moisturizing and helps to reduce eye wrinkles.

I have been using this product for over 15 years, from its first iteration as Wrinkle Resist 24 eye cream. It was then reformulated as Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream, and I continued to use it consistently. It was by far the best eye cream I had tried. Unfortunately, the new formulation stings the skin just outside the corner of my eyes, so there is no way I can use this any more. Why must cosmetic companies continually change products that their customers already love? So disappointing!
I love the eye cream. Unfortunately it looks like someone scooped out a small portion.
Been a faithful user for many years. Great product, highly recommend.
Thank you for free product from Influenster - SHISEIDO BENEFIANCE WRINKLE SMOOTHING EYE CREAM! Love how it absobs rapidly doesn't look greasy If your looking for a good eye cream right here it is!
I really like this eye cream. When I received it in the mail, it looks like someone scooped out a small amount from the jar. I was really disappointed. It was a hassle to return and reorder.

Shiseido has been around for ages at this point, so when I got this sample I knew that I would not be disappointed. And I definitely was not! Shiseido is one of the most well-known Asian skin care brands within my family, and I have grown up using their products whenever we were able to get our hands on them. Yes, they tend to be on the pricier side, but boy, are they 100% worth it! Even this small sample back blew me away with how powerful and fast-acting the eye cream was. Shiseido really knows what they're doing, and there's a reason why they have such a huge following. 10/10 would DEFINITELY purchase!

avis.titre: Good Texture, But the Fragrance and Finish Miss the Mark
avis.texte: I really wanted to like this eye cream. The texture itself is pleasant. It spreads easily, and just a small amount is enough for both eyes, which makes the jar last a long time. The scent is another story. While it does smell nice, the fragrance is much too strong for an eye cream and lingers for hours. I could still notice it two hours after applying. The biggest drawback for me is how the cream sits on the skin. Instead of absorbing, it leaves a film that feels greasy and heavy throughout the day. Overall, this eye cream has potential, but the strong fragrance and greasy texture keep it from being a product I'd reach for again.

avis.titre: One of the best eye creams
avis.texte: One of the best eye creams. I am 64 and having been using this product for at least 10 years. Love it!

I love how it absobs rapidly doesn't look greasy, and you can feel it actually like tingling when it's absorbing makes your under eyes feel cool and refreshing,i received a sample and I really do like it
I received a sample of this eye cream and it's the best I have ever used for Dark Circles! I seen fast Results If your looking for a good eye cream right here it is!
Unfortunately, I had a reaction to something in this product. Can't find the packing list, otherwise I'd return it
Not a fan. This eye cream doesnt seem to soak in, it sits on your skin and gives an all day greasy feeling.
This is my favorite eye cream and I love that I can get it at Ulta. I feel it works well on fine lines and is gentle for the sensitive skin around my eyes.
out of all my products I use and try, this one is my favorite by far!
This is the best under eye moisturizer… and I've tried them all.
Thick, rich, creamy, moisturizing eye cream. Helps dry eyelids and under eyes. I use is AM and PM
